context: We obtained an Ω(n3/4 ) lower bound for the quantum query complexity of Subgraph Isomorphism Problem for graphs, improving upon previously known Ω(n2/3 ) bound for the same. We extend our result to the 3-uniform hypergraphs by exhibiting an Ω(n4/5 ) bound, which improves on previously known Ω(n3/4 ) bound. Besides the obvious question of settling the randomized and quantum query complexity of the Subgraph Isomorphism problem, there are a few interesting questions that might be approachable. We list some of them below: I Question 1. Is it true that for any n-vertex graph H we have: (a) R(fH ) = Ω(αH · n)? (b) R(fH ) = Ω(n2 /dHavg ))? 2 (c) R(fH ) = Ω(n /χH )? I Question 2. Is it true that for any 3-uniform hypergraph H we have: Q(fH ) = Ω(n)?
